download_strategy.description: Critical issues embedded for instant start. High/Medium/Low downloaded in background.

groups.description:
{
  "fix": "1. Validate and sanitize all user inputs before using them in command execution.
2. Replace direct command string concatenation with a safer approach using ProcessBuilder with a list of command and arguments.
3. Avoid executing system commands with user-supplied input where possible. Refer to OWASP Top 10 A03:2021 - Injection for guidance.",
  "correctedCode": "Before:
ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder("sh", "-c", "command " + userInput);

After:
List<String> command...
Ensure the parameter is validated for null before processing to avoid unnecessary exceptions and improve performance by reducing runtime checks. Complexity: O(1) for validation check.

fix_pattern.instructions: Ensure the parameter is validated for null before processing to avoid unnecessary exceptions and improve performance by reducing runtime checks. Complexity: O(1) for validation check.

groups.description: Avoid creating a new Random instance for a single use. Instead, reuse a static instance or use ThreadLocalRandom for better performance. Complexity reduction from O(n) to O(1) for random generation.

fix_pattern.instructions: Avoid creating a new Random instance for a single use. Instead, reuse a static instance or use ThreadLocalRandom for better performance. Complexity reduction from O(n) to O(1) for random generation.
